# minimax-openai-bridge

> Go HTTP adapter that exposes an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint and
> translates requests to MiniMax embo-01. Enables Mem0 OSS and other
> OpenAI-compatible clients to use MiniMax embeddings without learning the
> MiniMax native schema.

## Overview

- Name: minimax-openai-bridge
- Purpose: OpenAI-compatible HTTP adapter for MiniMax embeddings (embo-01) and chat completions; provides key-slot rotation on quota/rate-limit failures so Mem0 OSS can use a single base URL for both extraction and embeddings.
- Language(s): Go
- License: MIT
- Authoritative README: <https://github.com/nfsarch33/minimax-openai-bridge#readme>
- Source of truth branch: `main`

## Quick Start

- Build and run:
  ```
  go run ./cmd/minimax-openai-bridge
  ```
- Endpoints:
  - `POST /v1/embeddings` — OpenAI-compatible embeddings
  - `POST /v1/chat/completions` — proxied chat completions
  - `GET /healthz` — health check
- Configuration via environment variables:
  - `BRIDGE_ADDR` (default `127.0.0.1:8500`)
  - `MINIMAX_API_KEY_1`, `MINIMAX_API_KEY_2`, `MINIMAX_API_KEYS` — key slots with rotation
  - `MINIMAX_EMBEDDING_MODEL` (default `embo-01`)
- Run tests: `go test ./...`
- Minimum runtime prerequisites: Go 1.22+

## Key Concepts

- OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings` translates to MiniMax `{texts, type}` schema
- Embedding type determined by `user` field: `db` for storage, `query` for search
- Key-slot rotation: multiple API keys rotate on quota or rate-limit failures
- Also proxies `/v1/chat/completions` for unified Mem0 base URL

## Runnable Examples

- Run bridge: `go run ./cmd/minimax-openai-bridge`
- Test: `go test ./...`

## Related Repos

- [mem0-mcp-go](https://github.com/nfsarch33/mem0-mcp-go) — Mem0 MCP server that uses this bridge for embeddings

## Operational Notes

- Issue tracker: <https://github.com/nfsarch33/minimax-openai-bridge/issues>
- Keep MiniMax keys in environment variables only; never pass on argv
